channel.title: AI Daily Watch: Windows, Autopilot & Intune
channel.description: Windows 11 and Insider builds, Windows AI features, Windows Autopilot and Microsoft Intune.

item.title: Windows 11 26H1 preview adds WinRE remote-management support for MDM providers
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft’s October 28 preview update KB5127653 for Windows 11 version 26H1 adds a recovery remote-management plug-in that extends Windows Recovery Environment management capabilities for MDM providers. The update also includes other Windows improvements, but this new MDM recovery capability is the notable endpoint-management change.

item.title: Microsoft releases Windows 11 preview KB5127936 for versions 25H2 and 26H2
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft’s October 28 preview update KB5127936 applies to Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 26H2. It includes changes such as refreshed Gaming Task View and Wi-Fi profile reuse in Windows Recovery Environment, alongside other feature and quality improvements.

item.title: Microsoft confirms removal of seven eMudhra certificates from Edge trust list
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft updated its eMudhra response to confirm that it removed the seven affected certificates from the Microsoft Edge trust list on October 27. The update also explains the impersonation and malicious-code-signing risks and warns organizations to assess carefully before restoring local trust.

item.title: Microsoft releases KB5134133 certificate trust update for Windows 11 24H2–26H2
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft published KB5134133, a cumulative non-security out-of-band update for Windows 11 versions 24H2, 25H2, and 26H2. It is intended for devices that do not receive current certificate trust list updates, such as disconnected devices or devices unable to access Microsoft’s certificate-update service.

item.title: Microsoft publishes its October 2026 security update release, including Windows updates
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft’s Security Update Guide lists its October 2026 security release as released on October 26 and includes cumulative updates for Windows. The release page reports 1,105 Windows vulnerabilities addressed and flags a Windows Shell security feature bypass vulnerability with exploitation detected.
